en: Colorized historic street scene viewed through a dark archway, showing a row of multi‑story townhouses with gabled roofs along a cobblestone market square. Horse‑drawn carts stand in front of the buildings, and shop signs in German hang on the façades. Printed red text at the top identifies the view as Hirschberg i. Schles., the northern market row looking toward the 'Ganslauben'.
